svg.title: Where the files live
svg.desc: The toolkit's own files, its commands, skills, agents and scripts, live in the plugin cache on your machine and change only with a plugin update; none of them are copied into your project. In your project, setup seeds a few files once and then they are yours: CLAUDE.md, LESSONS.md, DESIGN-PROFILE.md, the .claude/toolkit folder for your own extensions, and settings.local.json. The rules file .claude/rules/toolkit.md is the toolkit's, and your own notes go under its project line. Files made as you work, plans, artifacts/html, reports and CODEBASE_MAP.md, stay out of git.
